column3: “Post” is rendered “guard post,” and “fortification” “rampart”; “by me” is rendered “to me,” and “bring back on my complaint” “how I may reply when I am reproved.”
“Write down” is rendered “Record,” and “make it clear” “inscribe it.”
“Pant to the end” is rendered “hastens toward the goal,” and “lie” “fail”; “if it will delay” is rendered “Though it tarries.”
“It is swollen” is rendered “as for the proud one”; “faithfulness” is rendered “faith.”
“For the wine is treacherous” is rendered “wine betrays the haughty man”; “throat” is rendered “appetite.”
“A saying … a mocking song, riddles” is rendered “a taunt-song … mockery and insinuations,” and “pledges” “loans”; “makes heavy on himself” is rendered “makes himself rich.”
“Those who pay interest to you” is rendered “your creditors”; “those who make you tremble” is rendered “those who collect from you.”
“Plundered” is rendered “looted,” and “bloods of humankind” “human bloodshed”; NASB supplies “done to.”
“Gains unjust gain evil” is rendered “gets evil gain,” and “harm” “calamity.”
“Planned shame” is rendered “devised a shameful thing”; “sinned your self” is rendered “you are sinning against yourself.”
“From the woods” is rendered “from the framework”; NASB adds “Surely.”
“Bloods” is rendered “bloodshed,” and “injustice” “violence.”
“For the sufficiency of vanity” is rendered “for nothing.”
“To know” is rendered “With the knowledge of.”
“Your rage” is rendered “your venom,” and “mix in” renders “pouring out”; “neighbor” is rendered “neighbors.”
“Be counted as uncircumcised” is rendered “expose your own nakedness”; “disgrace” is rendered “utter disgrace.”
“Cover” is rendered “overwhelm”; NASB renders “will terrify them” as “by which you terrified them.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Relies” is rendered “trusts,” and “dumb” “speechless.”
“Wake up … awake” is rendered “Awake … Arise”; “it will teach?” is rendered “that is your teacher?”
“Hush!” is rendered “Let all the earth be silent.”
